inputs.prompt:
Original cinematic for Paper Lantern City. A handcrafted flat cut-paper diorama with
fine visible paper fibers, clean cuts, twelve separated flat layers, slight offset cast shadows,
dark indigo foreground silhouettes, warmer translucent distant paper. Restrained indigo #141A33,
purple #2A1E3D, apricot #D9A066, dusty pink #C97B84 and teal #4E9A92. Ordinary 1990s China,
square apartment buildings, roller shutters, cassette recorder, bicycle, folding tables.
No photographic realism, plastic, 3D bevels, ancient Chinese architecture, ancient costumes,
white highlights, white flashes, text, lettering, watermark, graphic overlays or borders.
Keep exposure stable. Slow deliberate movement. No dialogue, narration, singing or music;
only the specifically described quiet Foley. Preserve flat paper texture throughout.
Extreme macro view of a single clean flat muted apricot paper sheet edge in the base of a dark wooden shadowbox lamp. Black liquid ink enters from lower left and creeps slowly from left to right into the fine paper fibers. Tiny capillary branching feathered ink edges clearly visible. Behind it, separate upright flat teal and mauve paper layers form a miniature old Chinese town in soft focus. Restrained directional wet highlights cover less than five percent of the ink. No splashing, no tentacles, no creature yet. Camera tracks slowly along the creeping ink edge. Intimate faint paper fiber crackle and soft liquid trickle.
